hz7_front.topic: The support front, 8 Oct 2023 - Sept 2024: cross-border fire, displacement, Majdal Shams, Shukr, journalists

claims.text: On 8 Oct 2023 Hezbollah said it attacked '3 Zionist occupation sites' in the Shebaa Farms 'in solidarity with the victorious Palestinian resistance'; Israel answered with artillery and a drone strike on a Hezbollah post
Naim Qassem told AP (July 2024): 'If there is a cease-fire in Gaza, we will stop without any discussion.'

ACLED, 7 Oct 2023-18 Oct 2024: at least 13,608 cross-border attacks; Israel 11,238 (about 83%), killing at least 2,318 in Lebanon; Hezbollah and allied groups 2,370, killing at least 41 Israelis; more than 3,300 attacks 20 Sep-18 Oct 2024

ACLED to 20 Sep 2024: Israel 8,099 events vs Hezbollah 1,623; 798 deaths in Lebanon vs 28 in Israel; events not munitions; IDF called the analysis baseless and said over 9,000 Hezbollah projectiles had crossed since 8 Oct
ACLED one-year: 9,902 Israeli violent events in Lebanon, 449 localities hit; IDF said 12,400 projectiles fired toward Israel
IOM: 76,018 displaced in Lebanon by 4 Jan 2024; 110,099 displaced from south Lebanon since 8 Oct 2023 (IOM report 13 Aug 2024)
About 60,000 residents of northern Israel displaced per official data; about half not returned by March 2025; return from 1 March 2025

Majdal Shams 27 Jul 2024: 12 Druze children and teens (about 10-16) killed on a football pitch, at least 42 injured; Israel and Blinken attributed to Hezbollah (Falaq-1); HRW said damage consistent with Falaq-type rocket; Hezbollah denied: 'no connection to this incident'

30 Jul 2024 Israeli strike in Haret Hreik killed Fuad Shukr; health ministry: 3 killed incl 2 children, 74 wounded; Israel said Shukr was responsible for Majdal Shams; Haniyeh killed in Tehran the same night

Reuters found two Israeli tank rounds 37 seconds apart killed Issam Abdallah on 13 Oct 2023 and wounded six including AFP's Christina Assi; Amnesty and HRW reached consistent conclusions; Israeli army said it was investigating and does not target journalists

hz7_pagers.topic: Pager and radio detonations 17-18 Sept 2024: toll, method, law, acknowledgement

claims.text: Health minister Firas Abiad on 18 Sep: 12 killed incl two children and four health workers, 2,750-2,800 wounded by pagers
Abiad, 19 Sep 2024: pagers 12 killed, 2,323 injured; walkie-talkies 25 killed, 608 injured

Times of Israel Nov 2024: 39 killed, more than 3,400 wounded; tolls did not distinguish civilians from members; Iran's ambassador Mojtaba Amani wounded; Hezbollah official told Reuters about 1,500 fighters out of commission

NYT (via L'Orient): BAC Consulting in Budapest held a Gold Apollo licence; at least two other shell companies concealed Israeli manufacture; PETN in batteries; shipments from summer 2022, increased in 2024; BAC CEO denied making devices; Gold Apollo said BAC was responsible

Former Mossad officers on 60 Minutes: walkie-talkie plan began about ten years before; Hezbollah bought over 16,000 walkie-talkies; pager work from 2022; about 5,000 pagers; shell company in Hungary; claimed design to harm only the holder

UN experts (19 Sep 2024): 'terrifying' violations; simultaneous attacks 'would inevitably violate humanitarian law, by failing to verify each target'; could be war crimes; booby-trap disguised as harmless object

Türk at Security Council 20 Sep 2024: IHL 'prohibits the use of booby-trap devices in the form of apparently harmless portable objects'; 'This cannot be the new normal'; Danon: Israel would 'do everything we can to target those terrorists'
HRW's Lama Fakih: device whose location 'could not be reliably known would be unlawfully indiscriminate'; Amended Protocol II Art 7(2); defenders John Spencer and William Boothby argued lawful
Netanyahu told cabinet 10 Nov 2024 'The pager operation and the elimination of Nasrallah were carried out despite the opposition' of senior officials; office confirmed 11 Nov
Nasrallah 19 Sep 2024 called it 'a declaration of war', 'an unprecedented and historic blow'; fighting 'will not stop before the war in Gaza ends'
Gallant 18 Sep 2024: 'The center of gravity is moving northward'; return of northern residents the task

hz7_war.topic: September-November 2024 war: air campaign, Nasrallah, ground invasion, UNIFIL, toll, 27 Nov ceasefire terms and US letter

claims.text: ACLED: over 1,700 Israeli strikes in Lebanon in September 2024 (+125% on August); about 200 airstrike events on 23 Sep; ministry 569 killed on 23 Sep incl 50 children, 94 women; at least seven senior Hezbollah figures killed in last week of September incl Nasrallah
AP 24 Sep 2024: 558 killed in two days of strikes (health ministry)

ACLED: over 3,250 Israeli airstrike events in Lebanon 16 Sep-25 Oct 2024; airstrike events in Sept and Oct higher than any month it recorded in the region since 2017; an event can include several strikes; Hezbollah still firing hundreds of rockets daily; 13 Oct drone killed four Golani soldiers near Binyamina
ACLED November 2024: air campaign fell over 20% from October; Hezbollah attacks fell 46%; up to 250 projectiles on 24 Nov

Nasrallah killed 27 Sep 2024 in Dahiyeh strike on what Israel called an underground compound; experts said damage consistent with 2,000-pound-class bombs; at least eight F-15I; Hezbollah confirmed 28 Sep
1 Oct 2024: Israel announced 'limited, localized, and targeted ground raids' by the 98th division; Qassem vowed to continue; Pentagon sending a few thousand more troops
Hezbollah confirmed 23 Oct 2024 that Hashem Safieddine was killed in an Israeli strike

UNIFIL 10 Oct 2024: Israeli tank fired at Naqoura HQ observation tower, two Indonesian peacekeepers hurt; Israel said Hezbollah operates near UN posts and it warned UN forces; Italy's Crosetto said could be war crimes; White House 'deeply concerned'
Abiad 4 Dec 2024: at least 4,047 killed and 16,593 wounded since 8 Oct 2023; 3,402 killed after 15 Sep 2024; 790 women and 316 children; no civilian/fighter breakdown
Alma (Israeli research centre): 45 Israeli civilians and 83 soldiers killed in the northern arena 8 Oct 2023-27 Nov 2024; 5,185 Hezbollah attacks

Security cabinet approved ceasefire 10-1 on 26 Nov 2024; Biden: 'designed to be a permanent cessation of hostilities'; Netanyahu: Israel 'preserving full military freedom of action'; reasons: focus on Iran, rest and restock, isolate Hamas; Lebanon nearly 3,800 killed per AP at that date; Ben-Gvir 'a historic mistake'

Ceasefire text (US and France): from 04:00 27 Nov 2024; only official Lebanese forces armed south of Litani; dismantle unauthorized facilities; 10,000 LAF; Mechanism hosted by UNIFIL, chaired by the US, including France; Israeli phased withdrawal 'which should not exceed 60 days'; self-defence clause

US letter to Israel (Channel 13 via L'Orient): US 'recognizes Israel's right to respond to threats from Lebanese territory'; outside the south Israel reserves right to act against developing threats if Lebanon cannot; overflights for ISR

Before the deal Israel sought a US side letter on freedom of action (Channel 12); Hezbollah told mediators the 60-day truce left door open to 'Israeli aggression'; WSJ reported progress on Hezbollah dropping Gaza linkage
